label: TrueNAS Mini X+ 5-bay NAS
description: 5-bay desktop NAS with two RJ45 1/10GBASE-T ports as standard and a dedicated RJ45 IPMI port for out-of-band management. A PCIe slot can take an optional 2-port 10GbE card.
notes: Onboard: 2x RJ45 1/10GBASE-T (copper, speed follows the link partner) + 1x dedicated RJ45 IPMI port. The optional 2x SFP+ 10G add-on card is NOT modelled because it is an option, not onboard. IPMI is a separate management network (ASPEED BMC, iKVM over HTML5).
